note: Burke County GA (FIPS 13033) publishes parcels only through the qPublic/Schneider web viewer, which returns a bot-check (HTTP 403) and exposes no public ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable parcel file. The county's official site links only to qPublic. Search of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Burke County GA parcel service (the Burke County hits are North Carolina's). Commercial vendors (Regrid, DynamoSpatial, Equator, Acres, Rockford) sell parcel files but are not county-published services.
